data.body: `LAYER_NAME` (`aws-durable-execution-sdk-java-otel-plugin`) is a single, fixed-name, multi-region AWS resource, but the concurrency group is keyed by `github.sha`. A release-triggered run (sha of the release tag, via `publish_maven.yml`'s `publish-layer` job) and a `workflow_dispatch` run on `main` — or two releases published close together — get different `github.sha` values and therefore run concurrently against the same layer name/regions. Each run's `list-layer-versions` lookup can observe "no existing version with this description" before either publishes, so both can call `publish-layer-version`, creating duplicate versions with the same `Description` (the reuse-lookup only ever reads the first matching line), breaking the idempotency invariant this script is built around. Use a static group name so all publish runs against this shared layer serialize.
